summary: Frontend-only re-test of the College predictor tile (pure blood red). Signed in as QA learner 7004186276 and checked /rank at 390x844 and 320x700. ALL REQUESTED CHECKS PASSED. rank-tool-college is pure red in both states. The summary reads '180 marks · Normal · General'. rank-input-collapsed-edit reopens the form with 180. At 320x700 no text in any of the 5 tiles overflows.
